prompts.portrait: Create exactly one game-ready transparent pixel-art portrait of RUMBLET, adapting ONLY the two Rumblet owner reference images attached most recently. Preserve its low compact BROWN QUADRUPED beast body, sturdy four short legs with cream toe tips, cream muzzle and ear interiors, large expressive eyes, angular brown dorsal tuft, short tail, and the very large GRAY FRONTAL IMPACT PLATE covering forehead/nose with a SINGLE ORANGE central lozenge accent. Plate is integral attached head anatomy. Three-quarter front view facing left, brave calm planted neutral stance, full creature including every foot/ear/tail visible, centered with broad empty transparent margin. Crisp simple pixel-art edges and readable color clusters, cream/brown/gray/dark brown plus orange accent; faithful reference proportions, cute sturdy compact charging beast. No scene, ground shadow, text, labels, border, other creatures, weapons, special effects or sheet. This is a reusable creature collector RPG sprite, not a concept board. Transparent background.
prompts.combat: Create ONE production-ready transparent RGBA battle sprite atlas of EXACTLY this attached RUMBLET portrait design, never substitute another creature. Low compact BROWN QUADRUPED, cream muzzle/inner ears/toe tips, expressive eye, brown dorsal tuft and short tail, enormous attached GRAY FRONTAL IMPACT PLATE with a SINGLE ORANGE central lozenge mark, simple crisp pixel RPG style. Exactly FOUR equal columns by FIVE equal rows, 20 complete full-body poses; consistent LEFT-facing three-quarter camera/body scale. EACH figure including every foot, plate, ears, tuft and tail occupies at most 60 percent cell width and 65 percent cell height, leaving extremely generous EMPTY TRANSPARENT gutters on ALL sides. Entire anatomy fits inside own equal cell. Row1 IDLE: planted feet, breath, blink, settle. Row2 ATTACK CHARGE: lower plate and brace hind legs, compress stance, thrust/lunge forward head-first with plate, plant feet recover; communicate attack entirely through body poses, no long trails or external effects. Row3 HIT: flinch, backward recoil, crouch bracing plate, regain stance. Row4 FAINT: exhausted crouch, head lowered, lying curled complete quadruped, resting eyes shut. Row5 CAPTURE REACTION: alert, surprised upright head, calm cooperative crouch, content eyes closed. No orbs, bubbles, rings, stars, signs or debris. Same compact recognizable anatomy and plate in every row. No text, labels, grids, backgrounds, shadows or detached marks. TRUE alpha transparency, no overlaps, no cropped feet or ears. This full image is a strict evenly spaced 4x5 atlas with no decorative components.
